name: v21_low_operating_lease_burden
hypothesis: Lower future operating lease obligations relative to assets can indicate cleaner balance-sheet obligations and less fixed-cost pressure.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * future_minimum_operating_lease_payments / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * current_minimum_operating_lease_payment / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: New slow liability mechanism; no ROE/EPS/CFO/close-open anchor.

name: v21_ppe_depreciation_asset_efficiency
hypothesis: Lower accumulated PP&E depreciation burden and lower gross PP&E intensity may indicate less capital-intensive, more flexible operations.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * accumulated_depreciation_depletion_amortization_ppne / ppe_gross_value, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ppe_gross_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Tests asset-age/capital-intensity rather than capex flow; watch sector/sub-universe behavior.

name: v21_intangible_amortization_burden
hypothesis: High finite-lived intangible amortization relative to sales can proxy acquisition/intangible overhang without using goodwill stock directly.
expression: 0.65 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * accumulated_amortization_finite_intangibles / sales, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ppe_gross_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Alternative to goodwill/assets; should not be treated as a goodwill near-neighbor unless correlation says so.

name: v21_tax_payable_cleanliness
hypothesis: Lower taxes payable and unrecognized tax positions relative to assets may indicate cleaner tax accounting and lower unresolved tax risk.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * taxes_payable_total_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unrecognized_tax_positions / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Tax-cleanliness variant distinct from deferred-tax allowance; strict correlation gate against pw6jz8ob and MPpGzqwr.

name: v21_cash_tax_quality
hypothesis: Sustainable companies can pay taxes in cash without large unresolved tax liabilities; combine paid taxes with low unrecognized tax positions.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(income_taxes_paid_total / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unrecognized_tax_positions / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Positive cash-tax sign tests tax realism rather than low-tax avoidance.

name: v21_oci_balance_sheet_stability
hypothesis: Large accumulated OCI relative to assets can represent balance-sheet marks and currency/pension/security volatility; lower burden may be cleaner.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(accumulated_oci_net_of_tax_value) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * future_minimum_operating_lease_payments / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: OCI balance-sheet stability; watch whether abs() plus sparse footnote fields creates concentration.

name: v21_employee_benefit_liability_burden
hypothesis: Lower employee compensation and benefit liabilities relative to assets can indicate fewer accrued labor/benefit obligations.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * employee_compensation_benefit_liabilities / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * accumulated_oci_net_of_tax_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Benefit-liability channel; related to labor/pension accounting but distinct from prepaid/tax.

name: v21_near_term_debt_maturity_pressure
hypothesis: Lower near-term debt maturities and lower credit-facility balance relative to assets can reduce refinancing pressure.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt_maturities_repayments_next12m / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * credit_facility_outstanding_balance / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Debt maturity/liquidity pressure; distinct from debt_st/EV and debt extinguishment.
